in_urdu.name: عِبَادَة
in_urdu.long_meaning: عبادت سے مراد الله کی عبادت اور اس کے قرب کا حاصل کرنا ہے، جو کہ اسلام کے ارکان میں سے ایک ہے، اور اس میں الله کی عبادت، اور اس کے قرب کا حاصل کرنا شامل ہے

data.cultural_impact: In Islamic culture, "Ibadah" refers to acts of worship and obedience towards Allah. These acts include rituals such as prayer (Salah), fasting during Ramadan, giving Zakat (charity), and performing Hajj (pilgrimage to Mecca). Ibadah is an integral part of Muslim daily life, shaping their identity, community bonding, and societal norms. It is a continuous endeavor, producing a collective consciousness and sense of purpose towards Allah.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Ibadah is about building a profound relationship with Allah. Through Ibadah, Muslims express their devotion, seek forgiveness for their sins, and purify their souls with the intention of drawing closer to Allah. The concept of Ibadah is a reminder of the Primary Essence of Allah as the ultimate Reality, and the secondary essence of human beings as the servants of Allah. It instills humility, gratitude, and godliness, encouraging Muslims to prioritize their spiritual connection above worldly desires.
